title: AppLocker to WDAC (App Control for Business) Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (migrate application control from legacy AppLocker to WDAC/App Control for Business; policy translation, audit-then-enforce, coexistence, lockout risk).
Distinct from application-control-wdac (net-new WDAC implementation); this is the AppLocker-replacement MIGRATION. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Retire AppLocker for WDAC — stronger, OS-level app control, migrated without locking anyone out
problem: AppLocker has served its time, but WDAC (App Control for Business) enforces deeper at the OS level and aligns with modern security practice. The risk in switching is real: get a WDAC policy wrong and you lock users out of the apps they need. This solution is the controlled migration from AppLocker to WDAC — translate existing AppLocker rules, build WDAC policy, run it in audit mode to catch gaps, then move to enforcement in rings, with AppLocker coexistence handled so nothing breaks mid-cutover.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — why WDAC beats AppLocker (OS-level enforcement), the migration model (translate → audit → enforce), AppLocker/WDAC coexistence, and managed-installer / ISG considerations delivered via Intune.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows, the existing AppLocker policy export, a WDAC authoring approach, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: export/translate AppLocker rules, author the WDAC policy, deploy in audit mode via Intune, analyze audit events and close gaps, move to enforcement by ring, retire AppLocker, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — AppLocker/WDAC state discovery, audit-event and policy validation, a migration coverage and block-risk report, safe remediation (audit-mode revert), and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The controlled migration from AppLocker to WDAC (App Control for Business) — translate rules, run audit mode to catch gaps, move to enforcement in rings, and retire AppLocker without lockouts. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
